title: Robotics Agent Skills
oneLiner: Reusable robotics agent skills for ROS1, ROS2, and embodied AI development workflows.
summary: Robotics Agent Skills is an open-source agent skill resource focused on reusable robotics agent skills for ros1, ros2, and embodied ai development workflows.
whyItMatters: Robotics Agent Skills matters because the agent ecosystem is moving from one-off prompts to reusable skills, instructions, and workflow packs. It gives builders a source-backed way to inspect, adapt, and compare task-specific agent capability instead of reinventing the same prompt structure every time.
bestFor: Builders looking for reusable agent skills
notFor: Teams that need a fully managed closed product with no repository review
Workflows that cannot tolerate experimental community-maintained skill packs

coreStrengths.title: Reusable skill packaging
coreStrengths.description: Robotics Agent Skills treats repeated agent behavior as reusable files or workflows rather than one-off prompts.
coreStrengths.whyItMatters: Reusable packaging is the difference between a clever demo and an operational agent workflow.

coreStrengths.title: Source-backed adaptation
coreStrengths.description: The public repository gives teams a concrete starting point for forking, pruning, and adapting skills to their own standards.
coreStrengths.whyItMatters: Agent skills often need local conventions, so editable source is more valuable than a static prompt.

coreStrengths.title: Useful for capability mapping
coreStrengths.description: The project helps OpenAgent readers see which skill categories are emerging around coding, security, design, marketing, research, and operations.
coreStrengths.whyItMatters: A good skill directory should help builders understand the shape of the ecosystem, not only collect links.
